## Purpose and Entry Points
Nasiko is a Rust control plane for deploying, securing, routing, and observing A2A v1.0 agent containers. The server is the sole ingress and proxy boundary; agents are not directly public. Primary executables are the control-plane server at `server/src/main.rs`, CLI at `cli/src/main.rs`, and standalone LLM router at `llm-router/src/bin/llm-router.rs`. The dashboard is embedded vanilla-JS UI rooted at `ui/web/index.html`.

## Control-Plane Server
The Axum-based server composes HTTP APIs, authorization, runtime control, embedded UI, and shared state. Its application wiring and lifecycle begin in `server/src/main.rs` and `server/src/lib.rs`; state/configuration boundaries are represented by `server/src/state.rs` and `server/src/settings.rs`. API domains include agents, chat, builds, catalog, MCP, secrets, usage, and observability.

## Agent Lifecycle and Execution
Agent deployment accepts/builds source or images, stores versions, starts containers, and resolves live endpoints. Lifecycle management lives in `server/src/agents/deployments.rs`, `server/src/agents/build_worker.rs`, and `server/src/agents/versions.rs`. The runtime abstraction supports Docker in OSS via `runtime/src/lib.rs` and `runtime/src/docker/mod.rs`; endpoint lookup is isolated in `agent-proxy/src/lib.rs`. Example independently containerized A2A agents under `agents/` are templates/seed workloads, not part of the control-plane binary.

## A2A Dispatch, Routing, and Safety
Incoming chat/agent requests either use semantic selection or a direct generic proxy path. Server routing/proxy integration is in `server/src/router/a2a_dispatch.rs`, `server/src/agent_proxy.rs`, and `server/src/chat/routes.rs`. The orchestrator performs shortlist-by-vector similarity, context reranking, and final selection through `orchestrator/src/engine.rs`, `orchestrator/src/selector.rs`, and `orchestrator/src/reranker.rs`. Redis-backed flow limits and trace context constrain cascades—depth, fan-out, token budget, timeout, and cycles—through `flow/src/guard.rs` and `flow/src/context.rs`.

## Identity, Access, and Secrets
Authentication combines local JWT/login and optional OIDC; user RBAC/ownership and agent-to-agent ACLs are independently enforced before protected operations. Core boundaries are `server/src/auth/middleware.rs`, `server/src/acl.rs`, and `auth/src/service.rs`. Secrets are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM in `secrets/src/lib.rs` and injected at deploy time; no application-level agent code should receive platform master credentials.

## LLM and Tool Egress
Agents call platform-controlled endpoints rather than provider keys or tool credentials. `llm-router/src/handlers/chat.rs` normalizes inbound OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini formats via `llm-router/src/inbound/`, then resolves routing/provider credentials and invokes OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or OpenRouter adapters under `llm-router/src/providers/`. The MCP gateway merges tool catalogs, authorizes calls, manages OAuth/credentials, and connects custom or Composio-backed MCP services via `mcp-gateway/src/router.rs`, `mcp-gateway/src/authorizer.rs`, and `mcp-gateway/src/oauth.rs`.

## Persistence, Registry, and Observability
Postgres holds durable control-plane metadata, with schema evolution in `migrations/`; Redis serves flow/state needs; S3-compatible RustFS stores OCI content. The embedded OCI Distribution v2 registry exposes manifests/blobs and S3-backed storage in `oci/src/routes/` and `oci/src/storage.rs`. Telemetry is propagated through proxy/dispatch paths and exported through OTel; pricing and Tempo/Loki integration are implemented in `observability/src/lib.rs`, `observability/src/tempo.rs`, and `observability/src/loki.rs`. Docker Compose provisions Postgres, Redis, RustFS, OTel Collector, Tempo, Loki, and server via `docker-compose.yml`.

## Client Boundaries
The Rust CLI orchestrates local builds, OCI push/deploy, management APIs, chat, MCP, and coding-agent integration through `cli/src/commands/` and `cli/src/api.rs`. The dashboard consumes the same server APIs through `ui/common/services/api.js`; streaming behavior is handled by `ui/common/services/sse.js`. GitHub import/integration is an external-service boundary implemented by `github/src/service.rs` and surfaced by `server/src/github.rs`.
